method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a rectangle in the lower-right quadrant whose top-left corner is at O, with bottom side labeled 4 and one diagonal labeled 5. The lower-right corner of this rectangle lies on the circle. Since opposite sides of the rectangle are parallel and its diagonals are congruent, the unlabeled diagonal from O to the lower-right corner is also 5. Because O is the center and the lower-right corner is on the circle, this segment is a radius. Therefore the diameter is 2 × 5 = 10.
